title: Users are allowed to pause updates

report.title: {Items.Count} update {Plural(Items.Count, 'ring lets', 'rings let')} users pause updates

messages.businessImpact: Any user can postpone security updates on their own device, and the people most likely to do so repeatedly are the ones whose devices matter most.
remediation: Turn off the option that allows users to pause updates.
messages.cannotSee: Only a ring that grants the permission is reported. A ring that says nothing leaves the Windows default in place, which is not visible from here and is not the same as refusing it.
